title: Cover every acceptance commit-failure cause in the train

facts.note: Planner audience: fires while authoring or revising trains/wagons/WMBTs/acceptances.
Train and plan artefacts edited by the planner; exact globs depend on repository layout.
Task text naming the acceptance commit path or its failure causes.

values: train flow reaches the acceptance commit / Acceptance Authority boundary
facts.note: Requires a dispatch-graph observer that knows whether a train's flow reaches the acceptance commit step.

values: commit-failure cause not reachable / not registered / not resolvable / not terminating, and not validly deferred
facts.note: Validator binding is pending (owned by D5, #1089); until it is bound, per-cause coverage is reviewer-judged.

fires: A planner authors a train whose flow reaches an acceptance commit through the Acceptance Authority (whether or not the commit is the final step) and must plan handling for each commit-failure cause.
A train's dispatch graph handles version_conflict and authorization_refused but has no path or valid deferral for idempotency_conflict or authority_unavailable.
A planner revises a train and removes or reroutes a commit-failure handler so a cause no longer terminates.
doesNotFire: A train whose flow never reaches the acceptance commit / Acceptance Authority boundary.
Failure causes outside platform:acceptance:commit-failure.cause (e.g. generic step failures), which are handled by other coverage conventions.

A train in which every one of the four causes is either covered (reachable, registered, resolvable, terminating) or has an explicit tracked-and-expiring deferral; a deferral excuses only its own cause.

given: A train whose flow reaches the acceptance commit at the Acceptance Authority boundary
when: the planner authors or revises the train's dispatch graph and acceptances
then: Each of the four platform:acceptance:commit-failure.cause values (version_conflict, authorization_refused, idempotency_conflict, authority_unavailable) is reachable, registered in the dispatch graph, resolvable, and terminating.
prefer: Plan handling per cause: for each cause confirm its path (separate or shared) is registered, reachable, resolvable and terminating.
Treat commit-failure coverage as extending the train's coverage up to the Acceptance Authority boundary.
avoid: Covering only some of the four causes, or folding them into an unregistered generic failure path.
Paths that are registered but unreachable, reachable but unresolved, or that never terminate.
Deferrals without a tracking reference or expiry used to make coverage look complete.
unless: A specific cause has an explicit tracked-and-expiring deferral (excuses that cause only).
why: Acceptance commits can fail for four distinct reasons at the Acceptance Authority boundary; any cause that is unreachable, unregistered, unresolvable or non-terminating can strand the train.
evidence: For each of the four causes, the dispatch graph contains a registered path (dedicated or shared) reachable from the acceptance commit, with a resolution and a terminal state.
Any uncovered cause has its own deferral record with a tracking reference and an expiry that has not passed.
verifier_detail: Closed cause set: platform:acceptance:commit-failure.cause = {version_conflict, authorization_refused, idempotency_conflict, authority_unavailable}; check all four individually.
Four per-cause properties: reachable, registered in dispatch graph, resolvable, terminating. A shared handling path satisfies a cause if all four properties hold for that cause.
Deferral is valid only if explicit, tracked and expiring, and applies per cause.
Pending binding: validator owned by D5 (#1089). Until bound, compliance is reviewer-judged.
audit: Pending binding - validator owned by D5 (#1089).

Term commit_failure_coverage (label 'Commit-failure coverage'): the four acceptance commit-failure causes are each reachable+resolvable+terminating, extending coverage to the Acceptance Authority boundary.
